answer: Forge-bound equipment leases. Each identity runs on one forge-issued execution slot whose key never leaves it; every action carries an opal signature from that slot's live lease, and the registry stores its fingerprint. One fingerprint signing for two identities in one epoch voids both leases, and the opal deposits burn like ember. Cloning needs one real slot per fake, and slots renew hardware attestation hourly, so renting slots out costs what honesty costs. An idle clone pays hourly renewal too; a lapse locks it out until re-attestation.
